summary.text:
We need write CODESYS FB_Task with ST_Pump struct and logic.

Let's reason about semantics: mode, start, stop, pumpGroup array in-out.

stop wins: if stop then all RunComd FALSE.
Else if start then:
- manual (!mode): RunComd[i] := selection[i]
- auto: top3 highest priority (ties lower index) RunComd TRUE, others FALSE.
Else retain RunComd (no changes).

Need supporting ST_Pump struct. Declaration:

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB_Task
VAR_INPUT
 mode: BOOL;
 start: BOOL;
 stop: BOOL;
END_VAR
VAR_IN_OUT
 pumpGroup: ARRAY[1..5] OF ST_Pump;
END_VAR
VAR
 // temp
END_VAR

Implementation:

IF stop THEN
 FOR i := 1 TO 5 DO pumpGroup[i].RunComd := FALSE; END_FOR
ELSIF start THEN
 IF NOT mode THEN
  FOR i... RunComd := selection
 ELSE
  auto top3
 END_IF
END_IF

Need declare i integer VAR.

Auto top3: For each i determine rank: count pumps j with priority > priority[i], or priority equal and j < i. If rank < 3 then top3. Since rank among 0..4. Implementation:

FOR i := 1 TO 5 DO
  rank := 0;
  FOR j := 1 TO 5 DO
    IF (pumpGroup[j].priority > pumpGroup[i].priority) OR
       ((pumpGroup[j].priority = pumpGroup[i].priority) AND (j < i)) THEN
      rank := rank + 1;
    END_IF
  END_FOR
  pumpGroup[i].RunComd := (rank < 3);
END_FOR

Need supporting_objects includes ST_Pump struct with declaration fields. Kind DUT. Declaration should be TYPE ST_Pump : STRUCT ... END_STRUCT END_TYPE likely. Let's craft.

No markdown. compile.
